decision.hard_constraint: OWS engine is ours; LangGraph is an internal library; embedded single-container default

confidence.A: Medium architectural feasibility; low unexecuted conformance

risk.A: High custom semantic/recovery work; reduced duplication through native reuse
risk.B: Medium qualification/vendor-profile risk; fails selected ownership requirement
risk.C: High operational and placement complexity; not initial scope

rationales: Estimated profile coverage potential; no executed coverage ratio
Native primitives + custom semantic corrections; qualification still mandatory
Framework maturity separate from new engine maturity
LangGraph community benefits internal reuse; no adoption ratio invented
Internal native agents remain composable alongside portable calls
Native reuse reduces duplication but OWS services remain significant work
OWS authority maintained; extensions deliberately conditional
Versioned IR and adapters permit new installed capabilities
Single-container embedded deployment lowers baseline component count, not HA risk
decision.note: Scores compare trade-offs only. B/C are excluded by user ownership constraint. Score changes cannot prove conformance or override that constraint. Previous B-now/C-later recommendation withdrawn.

revision.scope: Implement our own OWS engine using LangGraph as a library
requirements: Reuse native graphs/tasks/checkpoints wherever semantics are preserved
One container with embedded durable storage by default; external components configurable
Workflow and task behavior belongs in the workflow description; bootstrap/environment setup externalized
revision.validation: Source and artifact verification only; no full native backend conformance executed

implementation_modules.native_reuse: Native graph state schemas and compile validation
implementation_modules.custom_work: OWS YAML/JSON parser, pinned schema+semantic profile, reference/catalog resolver and capability admission
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Embedded files/catalog registry; network resolution only if permitted
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Schema and language profiles in workflow; catalog/provider implementations in bootstrap

implementation_modules.native_reuse: StateGraph private channels; LastValue/Overwrite and typed state
implementation_modules.custom_work: Full jq evaluator, exact raw/transformed input/output/export pipeline, context replacement and immutable descriptors
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Embedded jq library or bundled local jq subprocess; no required expression service
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Expressions and schemas in workflow; evaluator binary/version/resources in bootstrap

implementation_modules.native_reuse: StateGraph edges, conditional edges, subgraphs; native tasks for effects
implementation_modules.custom_work: Typed scope/control results; exit current scope versus workflow end; serial for semantics; scope-aware exceptions
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Native graph execution in the same process
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Control and error policy in workflow

implementation_modules.native_reuse: Native branch graphs, Send, isolated task results and checkpointed child graphs
implementation_modules.custom_work: Indexed ordered all-join output; race coordinator, durable winner election, loser cancellation and late-commit rules
implementation_modules.embedded_support: SQLite winner/child journal; native branch checkpoints; no required broker
implementation_modules.config_boundary: fork standard policy in workflow; unresolved race details in explicit profile extension

implementation_modules.native_reuse: RetryPolicy/TimeoutPolicy when equivalent; native checkpoints/tasks, interrupt and Command resume
implementation_modules.custom_work: OWS lexical retry/catch/time limits; invocation cancellation, effect keys, uncertain-effect reconciliation and definition pinning
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Native SQLite saver plus separate engine effect journal on a durable volume
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Declared retry/timeouts and durability extension in workflow; DB provider paths in bootstrap

implementation_modules.custom_work: Persisted due times, subscriptions/correlations, inbox/outbox, scheduler and lost-wakeup reconciliation
implementation_modules.embedded_support: SQLite queue and polling scheduler within one container
implementation_modules.config_boundary: wait/listen/schedule, correlation and duplicate policy in workflow; polling/broker bindings in bootstrap

implementation_modules.native_reuse: Native node/task execution and LangChain integrations where the operation contract matches
implementation_modules.custom_work: HTTP/OpenAPI/gRPC/AsyncAPI clients, script/shell/container boundaries, catalog capability bindings and result/error codecs
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Bundled clients and constrained subprocesses; container executor optional external binding
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Operation language/image/arguments/timeouts in workflow; installed executors and resource ceilings in bootstrap

implementation_modules.native_reuse: Native tasks/streams/interrupts as internal mechanisms; reuse official protocol SDKs
implementation_modules.custom_work: Version profiles, seven OWS MCP calls, current MCP extended turns; inbound/outbound A2A task/artifact/status/cancel/identity mappings
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Protocol APIs, mappings and cursors in the same container; remote agents/tools remain integrations
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Selected protocol/agent/tool and exposure behavior in workflow; credentials, transport servers and listeners in bootstrap

implementation_modules.custom_work: Assignment/approval policy, identity/audit, escalation, stale response rejection and durable correlation
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Embedded human-task journal/API; external UI/identity provider optional
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Approval, reassignment, escalation and resume rules in workflow/profile

implementation_modules.native_reuse: Runtime context and node metadata; tracing integration
implementation_modules.custom_work: Auth/token exchange, secret resolver, policy hooks, per-run audit identity, sandbox/network restrictions and redaction
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Local secret references and policy bindings; external IdP when delegated auth is used
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Operation auth and applicable policy in workflow; secret values/providers/trust/resource ceilings in bootstrap

implementation_modules.native_reuse: Checkpoint APIs/history, BaseStore, native streaming/cache and Runtime
implementation_modules.custom_work: OWS lifecycle history projection; profile schemas for graph memory, cache, state edits, branching and language-specific streams
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Python SQLite saver/store/cache; JS SQLite saver plus bounded store/cache adapter when requested
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Memory/cache/stream/time-travel behavior in workflow extension; implementation providers in bootstrap

implementation_modules.native_reuse: Native serializers/checkpointers with supported migrations; existing project CI harness
implementation_modules.custom_work: Profile extension overlay, bootstrap schema/defaults, parity/crash harness, qualified manifest and migration gates
implementation_modules.embedded_support: Single-container executable test runner; optional external service lanes
implementation_modules.config_boundary: Two separately validated documents; run-specific identity/input supplied by invocation API
